objects.name: Example: Conduction Demo B.V.
objects._note: abp-aansluiting (design.md Seed Data): flipped to true -- ADM-001's existing approved 2026-05/2026-06 NL PayrollRuns already each carry a fund:abp PensionFiling (pension-filing-upa-mvp REQ-PFU-007), so nl-abp-fund-required reports zero violations for ADM-001 with no new filing seeds.

objects.name: Example: Van der Berg Advies B.V. (DGA)
objects._note: single-person-modes (design.md Seed Data, reconciled to HEAD -- the design's ADM-003 slot was already taken by abp-aansluiting, so the DGA fixture lands on ADM-004): a single-person BV in dga_single_person mode. Its one seeded DGA Employee (employee-devries-dga: isDga true, grossMonthlySalary 3500 -- below the EUR 4.833,33/maand implied by the EUR 58.000 annual norm, no gebruikelijkloonJustification) proves GET /api/payroll/dga-status returns met:false and the MijnGebruikelijkLoon banner renders the warning variant, while occ hrmq:rules:audit still reports the same nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm violation it already did. nl-single-person-mode-employee-count is SATISFIED (exactly one active DGA). A user whose active administratie is ADM-004 sees Salarissen/Medewerkers but NOT org-chart/planning/team-approval menus (REQ-SPM-003).

single-person-modes (design.md Seed Data): the DGA of ADM-004. isDga true + grossMonthlySalary 3500 (annualised EUR 42.000, below the EUR 58.000 gebruikelijkloon norm) + no gebruikelijkloonJustification -> a nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm violation AND dgaStatus met:false. nextcloudUserId 'dga-devries' is a shape example (the hr-devries seed precedent) -- not a real dev-login account, so live self-service is demonstrated once such an account is linked; the dgaStatus contract itself is pinned by PayrollControllerDgaStatusTest.

objects.name: Example: Eenmanszaak Bakker (geen loon)
objects._note: single-person-modes (design.md Seed Data, ADM-004->ADM-005 reconciled to HEAD): a sole proprietorship in eenmanszaak_no_payroll mode with ZERO seeded Employee rows (a true eenmanszaak takes winstuitkering, never loon). A user whose active administratie is ADM-005 sees NO PayrollGroup/ProformaPayslipMenu entries (REQ-SPM-004) and none of the multi-person menus, while Medewerkers/MijnHrGroup remain. No loonheffingennummer -- no payroll is ever filed.

Example — seed data: the single-administratie shape a company HR user carries (design.md Seed Data), contrasted with the admin account's multi-client accountant book above. hr-devries is not a real Nextcloud account -- a shape example only, never resolved by the setter/switcher for the dev admin login.
